waypoints.title: MARQUEE TRAVERSAL INVARIANT (operator 2026-09-22): a notification must ALWAYS scroll offscreen -> onscreen -> offscreen at least once; never 'just appear', never vanish, never tear visually or temporally. The s91 ring fails the at-least-once half: pendingText is rebuilt from the model on every count change, so an item that arrives and expires before the next boundary never shows. Design: a QUEUE keyed by notification id (the model's IdRole / index key) — an arrival is appended with shown=false; at a boundary the next ring is [every queued item with shown=false] (expired or not), which then scrolls exactly once; an item still in the model after its rotation may be re-queued (it keeps cycling while active); an item removed from the model finishes its current rotation and is dropped at the boundary; the ring NEVER changes mid-rotation. Pure functions in marquee-body.js (ringNext(queue, modelIds) -> {ring, queue}) so the headless harness proves the invariant on synthetic arrival/expiry sequences

residue.title: THE FIELD AS AN APERTURE INTEGRAL (operator 2026-09-22: pips with a brightness RANGE, modelled as a supersampled mask over a higher-resolution backdrop scrolled at the display rate — pinholes over a moving scene; the brain synthesizes the motion). Each pip's brightness = ghostAlpha + coverage * (1 - ghostAlpha), coverage = the backdrop's ink under the pip's aperture at the current offset. In QML: the backdrop (text, icon raster, sparkline, QR) drawn once into a ShaderEffectSource with mipmaps; a ShaderEffect over the static field samples per pip at an LOD matched to the aperture (the box integral for one lookup); the scroll offset is a uniform, so no Row rebuild ever happens. This is what a real LED sign's sub-pixel smooth scroll IS (PWM at fractional offsets). COLLAPSE candidate: W47 (viewport = the vertical uniform), W48 (a sparkline is a backdrop), W34(a) (lit dots ARE the field's, graded not snapped), and the live twin of segment_topology.project / matrix_glyph's offline coverage rule (ink under a cell aperture) — reuse-search hit, not a new operator
